description: Resend the email for a pending invite that has not been accepted, unlike invite_user which creates a new invite. This sends a fresh email without modifying the invite record, expiry, or role; use get_user_invite first if you are unsure whether the invite still exists and list_user_invites to discover invite_ids.
name: resend_user_invite

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
